title: sampling
description: Structured sampling memo produced before fieldwork. Carries scope, population definition with completeness basis, risk-based stratification, sample method, sample size rationale, selection method, tolerable deviation rate with criterion source, sample drawn with control-total reconciliation, limitations, reviewer questions, and sign-off block. Downstream consumers: test-plan-builder references by sampling_id; workpaper-drafter consumes population definition, tolerable rate, and sample IDs; qa-workpaper reads the rationale during sufficiency review; exception-analysis reads the sample list and tolerable rate when classifying observed deviations.

sampling_id.description: Stable identifier per firm naming convention.

test_id.description: Optional foreign key into test-plan-builder output. Absent when the sampling memo precedes the test plan.

control_id.description: Firm control register ID for the control under test.

obligation_ids.description: Firm obligation register IDs the control addresses. May be one or more.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this memo was produced.

period_start.description: First day of the period the sample addresses.

period_end.description: Last day of the period the sample addresses.

business_unit.description: Name of the business unit owning the control. Role-level, not individual-level.

jurisdiction.description: Primary jurisdiction the test addresses. Multi-jurisdiction tests should list primary here.

scope_statement.description: Two to three sentences naming the population, the timeframe, and the test objective.

test_objective.description: Drives sample design. A combined test may need two samples (judgmental design plus statistical operating).

source_posture.description: Source posture under which the memo was produced.

reviewer.description: Reviewer must be a separate role from preparer. date_reviewed and sign_off_status are filled at sign-off.

population.description: Population stated in items the sample can draw from, with a named completeness basis. A population without a completeness basis is a methodology defect.

description.description: Population in items, not in source tables. Examples: 'account-opening packets opened in period'; 'error-resolution case files closed in period'; 'recertification packets generated in period'.

source_of_truth.description: System, report, or query identifier with run date and run-by role.

completeness_basis.description: How completeness is supported: reconciliation to control total, dual-extract comparison, system-of-record cut-off attestation. Names the reconciliation result.

stratification.description: Empty array allowed when the population is uniform on dimensions the test cares about; that no-stratification choice is documented in stratification_rationale.

factor.description: Stratification factor (transaction value, customer risk tier, privilege tier, etc.).

stratification_rationale.description: Why these factors and not others. Include the no-stratification rationale when applicable.

sample_method.description: haphazard is rarely defensible; flag for reviewer challenge and recommend a documented alternative.

sample_method_rationale.description: Two to three sentences tying method choice to test objective, population behaviour, and source posture.

confidence_level.description: Confidence level for statistical samples, expressed as a decimal (0.95 = 95%).

tolerable_deviation_rate.description: Tolerable deviation rate as a number plus its criterion source. The number alone does not pass.

value.description: Format as percentage, decimal, or '0% for [segment]'. Procedure-level or segment-level breakouts allowed.

criterion_source.description: Firm methodology / professional standard / regulator expectation / population-specific zero-tolerable convention.

procedure_level_breakouts.description: Data-point-level versus record-level rates; segment-specific rates.

expected_deviation_rate.description: Expected rate of deviation used in sample sizing. Source the prior-cycle observed rate or firm methodology default.

sample_size.description: Resulting sample size. For full-population, equals population size.

method_or_table_reference.description: Firm methodology / AICPA AU-C 530-derived tables / named statistical package, when statistical.

qualitative_basis.description: Factors and weights, named target categories, when judgmental.

floor_or_ceiling_reference.description: Firm methodology floor / regulator-handbook appendix conventions / prior-cycle benchmark, when judgmental.

full_population_justification.description: Population size; zero-tolerable scope; all items reachable in available time, when full-population.

seed_or_interval.description: PRNG seed for prng; interval and starting point for mus.

criteria_description.description: For judgmental-criteria: highest-dollar, highest-risk, longest-aged, most-recent, etc.

sort_key.description: Field used to order the population list before drawing. Reproducibility note.

sample_ids.description: Sample IDs drawn. Use sample_list_pointer for very large samples.

sample_list_pointer.description: Optional pointer to an external sample list when sample_ids is impractical to inline.

drawer_role.description: Drawer role; separate from sample-evaluator role where firm policy requires draw-and-evaluate separation.

control_total_reconciliation.description: Sample-draw output reconciled to population; named result.

limitations.description: What the sample cannot conclude on. Reviewer's protection paragraph in list form.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the named reviewer. Each question names the decision it supports.

confidence_label.description: Reflects evidence sufficiency for the population assertion, the criterion source for the tolerable rate, and the source posture under which the memo was produced. Per references/review-gates.md.

human_review_required.description: Always true. Sampling memo requires reviewer sign-off before fieldwork begins.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this memo must clear. Drawn from references/review-gates.md.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims. Every methodology assertion ties to a source with a section reference.
